I absolutely do not recommend this veterinary clinic, and if I could give it zero stars, I gladly would, I am so disappointed! Everything had started so well, and our dog had been a patient at this clinic since he was a puppy. For his routine care, there was never anything unusual to report; our dog was in excellent health and rarely sick. But things changed drastically when he started getting older and would occasionally choke or at least have difficulty breathing. At that point, we took him in for several checkups, and the different veterinarians who examined him all told us it was because he was getting old and his throat was narrowing. They prescribed a cough suppressant and lactulose to help him defecate. We had to bring our dog back because he still couldn't defecate despite this treatment, and as a result, he refused to eat. From that point on, several things shocked us. At first, we were surprised that they didn't even suggest an X-ray to see if there was anything more serious than simple constipation and a narrowed throat. It was our daughter who had to insist with the vets before they finally ordered an MRI and an X-ray, which revealed several lumps, including one near his heart. They then told us that to determine if it was cancer, they would have to sedate him, but that it was inadvisable given his age. In any case, surgery couldn't be considered since he was almost 14 years old, and he could die on the operating table. The vets gave him no chance, while we loved him so much that we would have done anything to try to save him, or at least alleviate his suffering. Even worse, from that point on, the vet made it clear that our only option was to have him put down, without any compassion whatsoever, and that we had to make an appointment as if he needed to be put down the following week! We felt like our dog didn't deserve any care or medical follow-up because he was 14 years old and considered old! Then, despite my repeated calls asking her to at least change his medication to help him relieve himself, they gave him nothing more than a cough suppressant and a useless medication to help him defecate, which didn't work, even though he was much sicker and they knew it! As if lactulose was the only medication available to help dogs relieve themselves and nothing else! This was in March, and we had to have our dog put down on July 27, 2026, four months after they advised us to have him put down! We can't help but feel guilty for having trusted these veterinarians who didn't help him have a dignified end of life by not even prescribing pain medication, since they didn't want to try anything to save him because they thought he was too old and that, in their opinion, he was going to die very quickly anyway... Shameful, since he lived for another four months afterward, but without any medical help, medication, or follow-up care, NOTHING!!! All these veterinarians reminded us of doctors who have no compassion for elderly people when they become dependent and ill!

A pigeon is injured with a twisted wing. I went to the clinic to ask if I could bring it in. There was only one other patient waiting, so it was far from crowded, but they refused, claiming they'd have to call the town hall, which, as we all know, won't do a thing.

The receptionist told me: "We can't do anything."

Well, actually, yes we can, because a quick examination, and in the worst-case scenario, if it had no chance of survival, an injection would end its suffering!
This clinic only cares about profit and shamelessly lets animals suffer.

Thirty years ago, I took my dog ​​to this clinic, which helped me a lot. Since then, I haven't been back, and I've heard some not-so-positive rumors. My son's Staffordshire Bull Terrier had a minor problem, so I made an appointment with a vet, and I was pleasantly surprised because it was exactly what I expected from the Dromel clinic. All the staff are very kind and they all do their work with passion. I thank them for everything. Whatever happens, I will go back.

It cost me 600 euros and I left with a prescription for cat food. 600 euros and I left with my sick cat, and they can't even tell me what illness my cat had. And on top of that, they mixed up my file. I'm really disappointed with this clinic. They even tried to offer me a payment plan; they think more about money than animals. Go there one day and tell them you don't have the full amount.
